name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (cast / status_inflict_spell). Accurately reflects the worker: it inflicts a status affliction (paralyze 0x1B/麻痺術 via sleep byte +0x26, silence 0x16/封咒術 via combat_aux_block[0] +0x27) on opponents via a ~50% RNG roll. No address residue; no domain-ID suffix to preserve.
purpose: STATUS-INFLICT spell worker: rolls a ~50% RNG check per target and on success deals a flat 10-HP bonus, sets the named status byte to a (rng%4)+2 turn timer, and credits 8x level pending XP; otherwise shows a miss.
logic_summary: Plays per-target impact + status-overlay-flicker anims. Loop over target_id_array[0..num_targets-1]: target_rc = &runtime_char_array[tid]. Land condition (short-circuit &&): status byte ((uint8*)target_rc)[sprite_id]==0 (not already afflicted) AND job_id != 0x19 AND job_id != 0x1A (boss/immune classes) AND (rng_state() % 100) < 0x32 (~50%). On hit: damage=fd2_apply_damage_and_award_xp(tid,10); show damage number (glyph 0x5E '^'); ((uint8*)target_rc)[sprite_id]=(rng_state()%4)+2 (timer 2..5 turns); pending_xp_credit += status_flags_block[0]*8 (8x = highest reward tier). On any miss: fd2_show_miss_indicator. After loop: fd2_composite_battle_frame(0); if aoe/fx-queue idx != 0 -> fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths(). Asm-verified: two RNG sites at 0x22DBA (IDIV 100) and 0x22DED (IDIV 4) both consume the fd2_advance_rng_state EAX return (MOV EDX,EAX/SAR EDX,0x1F/IDIV) - the Ghidra decompile's reuse of uVar4 for the modulos is the known EAX-tracking quirk; the source already applies the correction. Shared-epilogue cross-fn sharing (asm 0x22E3C JMP into fd2_cast_speed_boost_spell tail @ 0x22A7B, AoE==0 case JMP 0x22BBE) is a compiler size optimization re-emitted as the two inlined calls under the explicit AoE guard (Layer-2 functional equivalence).
signature: void fd2_cast_status_inflict_spell(uint32 caster_unit_id, uint32 spell_id, uint32 num_targets, uint32 target_id_array, uint32 sprite_id)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Caster unit id; forwarded to the two animation calls (impact + status-overlay-flicker).
params.reason: Generic Ghidra param_N placeholder; does not describe the value. Source already uses caster_unit_id; consistent with sibling casters (cast_ap/dp/speed_boost).

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Spell id, forwarded only to the impact/overlay animation calls (selects sprite set). Callers pass 0x1B (麻痺術) or 0x16 (封咒術).
params.reason: Generic Ghidra param_N placeholder. Source already uses spell_id; standard name across this family.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Number of targets (loop bound), compared signed against the iterator.
params.reason: Generic Ghidra param_N placeholder. Source already uses num_targets; standard across this family.

params.name: caster_idx
params.semantics: Pointer (as uint address) to the target-id byte array; each entry read as ((uint8*)target_id_array)[iter] (asm MOV ESI,[ESP+0x24]/ADD ESI,EAX/MOVZX [ESI]). NOT a caster index.
params.reason: Ghidra MISLABELS this 4th formal as caster_idx; it is in fact the target-id byte-array pointer (confirmed by asm and by the wrapper fd2_cast_status_spell_via_d1b which forwards its p_target_array here). Source already uses target_id_array.

params.name: sprite_id
params.semantics: Raw runtime_char byte offset of the status byte to set: callers pass 0x26 (bStatus_sleep_flag, paralyze 0x1B) or 0x27 (pCombat_aux_block[0] = silence, 0x16). Read/written as ((uint8*)target_rc)[sprite_id]; Ghidra renders it as the artificial pSprite_state[sprite_id-2] (pSprite_state sits at +0x02 so the index resolves to the same +sprite_id byte).
params.reason: Name 'sprite_id' is a Ghidra-struct artifact (derives from the pSprite_state field name) and is semantically misleading: the value is a status-flag struct byte offset, not a sprite id. The wrapper siblings fd2_apply_status_effect_with_anim and fd2_cast_status_spell_via_d1b already name this same arg status_byte_offset; proposing it for cross-family consistency (Stage-2 apply only; comment references to 'sprite_id' to be updated then). No address residue, but does not match usage.

returns.semantics: No return value; effects are applied in place (status bytes, HP via callee, pending XP global, on-screen numbers/indicators).
